name: atlas-one
description: Prompt operating system for structured reasoning.

prompts.title: Atlas One Core
prompts.useCase: Route any request to the right reasoning mode and output structure.

prompts.title: Analyze Mode
prompts.useCase: Understand a situation, system, idea or problem.
prompts.outputShape: Summary, key parts, patterns, risks or gaps, insight, next step.

prompts.title: Decide Mode
prompts.useCase: Choose between options and expose trade-offs.
prompts.outputShape: Context, options, trade-offs, recommendation, why, next action.

prompts.title: Architect Mode
prompts.useCase: Design a technical, product or workflow system.
prompts.outputShape: Goal, constraints, architecture, responsibilities, risks, recommendation.

prompts.title: Research Mode
prompts.outputShape: Question, known facts, evidence, uncertainty, implications, follow-up.

prompts.title: Explain Mode
prompts.useCase: Make a concept easier to understand.
prompts.outputShape: Short answer, plain explanation, example, confusion, takeaway.

prompts.title: Teach Mode
prompts.useCase: Teach a subject or skill step by step.
prompts.outputShape: Goal, prerequisites, lesson, practice, understanding check, next lesson.

prompts.title: Edit Mode
prompts.useCase: Improve existing text, docs or prompts.
prompts.outputShape: What changed, edited version, rationale, alternatives.

prompts.title: Coach Mode
prompts.useCase: Support reflection, guidance or behavior change.
prompts.outputShape: Current state, goal, blockers, coaching frame, small action, question.

prompts.title: Plan Mode
prompts.useCase: Turn a goal into sequenced work.
prompts.outputShape: Goal, assumptions, phases, task list, risks, definition of done.

prompts.title: Debug Mode
prompts.outputShape: Observed problem, likely causes, checks, fix path, verification, risk.

prompts.title: Review Mode
prompts.useCase: Critically assess code, docs, plans or releases.
prompts.outputShape: Findings, severity, evidence, fixes, open questions, summary.

prompts.title: Summarize Mode
prompts.useCase: Compress longer material into a useful summary.
prompts.outputShape: Short summary, key points, decisions, action items, missing context.

prompts.title: Create Mode
prompts.useCase: Create a new artifact, draft or template.
prompts.outputShape: Intent, draft, design choices, adaptation notes, next iteration.
